Grace L: Hey team — AcmeCorp POC needs a compliance onramp bundle: SOC2 excerpts, pen-test attestation, network/KMS diagram, and clarification on how Azure VNet egress is billed. Can we assemble + a short cost note by Friday?

Marco R: Quick Q — are they being billed for egress from our dedicated GPU VNet to their VNet? They said they saw potential bandwidth charges on their cloud bill.

Tom H: Short answer: it depends. If we peer into their VNet in the same region, traffic stays private (no public egress). Cross-region or traffic that traverses NAT/Gateway -> will show up as egress. Private Link/Private Endpoint avoids public egress.

Grace L: They will consume responses from our API (streaming). Does streaming add anything unusual?

Tom H: Streaming is still outbound traffic from our host to their endpoint. If endpoint is inside their peered VNet -> internal. If it exits to the internet -> billed as egress by the cloud provider. For a back-of-envelope estimate I need expected avg token/s and region pair.

Priya S: On pen-test letter: we provide a one-page attestation + scope statement. We do not share raw reports. Legal signs a cover attestation. Typical turnaround: 2 business days to draft, 3–5 days if signature routing needed.

Marco R: Can you drop the sample wording you usually send? I'll forward to Acme legal.

Priya S: Sure — sample: 
````
Redwood Inference Penetration Test Attestation
Date: <YYYY-MM-DD>
Scope: Redwood production inference control plane and serving runtime (redacted infra)
Attestation: A third-party penetration test was completed on <date-range>. No critical findings outstanding; medium/high findings mitigated as of <date>.
Contact: security@redwood.ai
````
We redact vendor specifics and don't include PII.

Grace L: Perfect. For SOC2 artifacts — can we give them a read-only proofpack link with SOC2 report excerpts and the control matrix?

evidence-bot: New evidence-request #4582 created by Grace L — items: SOC2 excerpts, pen-test attestation, network diagram, KMS key flow. Priority: high. ETA: 3 business days. :white_check_mark:

Tom H: KMS flow: we support customer-managed keys via Azure Key Vault (BYOK). For Private deployments we can integrate with HSMs — that is a separate on-prem contract.

Priya S: @Legal — Acme asked for the attestation to be signed and to name the signatory (they requested 'VP Legal'). Can Legal confirm signer and any standard redlines?

Legal: We can sign the standard pen-test attestation with VP Legal. We'll need to confirm indemnity items in the contract before named signature.

Grace L: Acme asked for the bundle by EOD Friday. Are timelines above doable?

Marco R: I'll prepare a one-page egress cost estimator (example: 1TB/month cross-region ≈ $90 egress + margin) and token/throughput guidance.

Tom H: FYI — if they want to avoid egress costs, recommend Private Link or hosting Dedicated in their VNet (private deployment). I'll add a short diagram.

Grace L: Thanks — I'll collect artifacts and drop to their SFTP once Legal signs. Contact at Acme: sarah@acme.com.

Marco R: Sending estimator to Sarah now. :thumbsup:

Priya S: I'll queue the attestation draft.

evidence-bot: Evidence bundle draft uploaded to internal proofpack #4582 (access: internal only).

Grace L: Great — looping in Legal and Security. Will update thread with final bundle link when ready.
